description: 1 double bedroom, 1 bathroom with bathtub, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Single-aspect apartment — windows on right facade(s). Kitchen is on an interior wall away from windows — less natural light at the cooking position. 1 double bedroom (no walk-in wardrobe, no en-suite), 0 single bedroom(s). Single bedrooms can each function as bedroom, home office, hobby room or guest room. Kitchen: single-wall, no island. Cook faces the wall, back to the living and dining area. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Dining table visible, approximately 4 seats. TV on wall left of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Bathroom config: 1 bathroom(s) with bathtub. Single bathroom — sequential morning routine. Largest bedroom close to entry and kitchen — convenient morning access, less acoustic separation from activity. Storage room adjacent to kitchen — usable as kitchen pantry, laundry room or general storage. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. From entry: kitchen is immediate, living area is short corridor. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits: singles or couples.
